title: Contract tests shared by the SQLite and S3 storage adapters
description:
Both adapters must keep working, but parity rests on matching protocol signatures and small per-adapter test files (five embedded S3 tests against three SQLite). Only the console storage reruns its native tests against S3 (src/decision_flywheel/s3_console_storage_test.py:145). EmbeddedStorage declares export_storage and restore_storage (embedded_storage.py:53) that S3EmbeddedStorage lacks.
Do: a parametrized pytest fixture that yields each storage domain (embedded, runtime, review, evaluation, batch) backed by SQLite in a temp dir and by the synthetic S3 fake, and one behaviour spec module per protocol exercising ordering, duplicate identities, latest_decision skipping superseded, learning-queue operations, meta round-trip, and the exception family from the S3 error-handling issue. Either implement export_storage/restore_storage on S3 or remove them from the protocol and move them to a SQLite-only mixin. Also fix the two open study bugs in the SQLite runtime store as part of the SQLite side: open the runtime database in WAL mode with a busy timeout above five seconds (tracker: 'A reader holding the runtime store for over five seconds fails the running step') and make replay resume idempotent for an interrupted cycle (tracker: 'Resuming a replay after a failed or killed cycle re-records that cycle's feedback'); close those two issues when done.
Done when: every protocol has a shared spec that runs against both back ends in make test, the protocol and the adapters agree method for method, the two study bugs are closed. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
